worker.note: F.1.1-Pi.2: PiSandboxWorkerAdapter (bridge + disposable worker container) is the PRODUCTION transport. Local fixture execution is development/test only (kind='test', allow_simulated repos). Production jobs always run through the sandbox/external worker.
worker.isolation_note: Personal-context isolation comes from the container/filesystem boundary, NOT from --ignore-rules (runtime audit: the flag does not change prompt composition).

limits.max_attempts_note: F.1.1-Pi.2: job.max_attempts (per job) takes precedence; this global value is only the fallback for legacy rows without a per-job value.
limits.max_review_cycles_note: F.2: bounded fix<->review loop; exhaustion -> WAITING_HUMAN (review_cycle_limit_reached).
limits.no_progress_note: F.1.1-Pi.2: progress signature hashes base/head sha + canonical changed-file names + diff hash + unmet criteria ids (not just changed-file counts).
limits.review_policy_note: F.2: production (kind=implementation) jobs ALWAYS require independent review (fixed in supervisor code; not disableable via MCP/config). Test-kind fixture jobs skip review.

transport.remote_note: populated by jobs/remote_worker.json once the user provides worker host info (worker/README.md)

coding-worker-smoke-test.note: fixture repo (supervisor regression + worker smoke test source)

fix-loop-fixture.note: F.2 real fix-loop fixture repo (bridge-side checkout: coding-worker/repos/fix-loop-fixture)

f2-fixloop.note: F.2 clean fix-loop fixture (bridge-side checkout: coding-worker/repos/f2-fixloop). Registered tests are deliberately narrower than the written contract.
